messages:
Noah G: Quick ask  converting contractor (Iris H) to a 0.6 FTE perm IC3. Proposed FTE comp $150,000 -> prorated base $90,000. Current S4 prorated cap for 0.6 is $88,000, so we're ~$2k over. Preferred start 2026-11-01, fallback 2026-11-15. What approvals do we need?

Talia P: Candidate verbal accepted. No relocation. Manager justification ready. Wants benefits pro-rated and PTO accrual.

Priya - People Ops: Routing checklist: 1) manager justification + org head signoff; 2) finance confirm prorate and funding; 3) comp committee for any >$2k prorate variance (this is borderline); 4) legal for contractor->employee conversion; 5) benefits for part-time eligibility and effective date. If you paste manager justification I'll open HR ticket. Also note payroll cutoff dates.

Noah G: Manager justification -> "Iris owns critical infra migrations; conversion maintains continuity and avoids extended contractor churn. Cost modeling shows conversion reduces overall spend over 6 months vs contractor extension. Candidate has relevant seniority and will mentor two juniors."

Finance Ops: Need org code + chargeback center. Confirming prorate math looks right. If committee asks for uplift, provide annualized budget impact.

Priya - People Ops: Thanks. Creating ticket HR-2987654321 and routing to finance@, comp-committee@, legal@, benefits@. Please reply in-thread with `+approve` or `-need info`.

Payroll Bot: FYI payroll cutoff for 2026-11-01 active start is 2026-10-20. If approvals miss that, earliest active payroll will be 2026-12-01 due to offshore payroll setup.

Comp Chair: We'll put this on the agenda. Because variance is ~2k over at 0.6 FTE, comp committee will review. Options: approve a band exception, shift to S5 (with justification), or approve equity/top-up instead of base. Which does candidate prefer?

Talia P: Candidate prefers base increase over equity. Equity-only solution likely wont fly.

Noah G: Confirm manager + org head signoff here. Org code ENG-PLAT. Candidate will accept 0.6 FTE and pro-rated benefits.

Comp Chair: +approve to move forward to formal committee review (not final sign-off). Please attach benchmarking and salary data. If committee deems variance >$2k, VP People approval may be required.

Priya - People Ops: Noted. @Finance Ops please confirm budget impact and whether VP escalation needed. @Legal please start contractor->employee checklist and confirm last invoice date to avoid overlap.

Finance Ops: Budget OK for 0.6 FTE in ENG-PLAT this FY. If final annualized uplift >$4k will need VP sign-off. At prorated level this location flags at ~$2k so comp committee can proceed.

Legal: Quick flag: confirm final written offer, IP assignment and NDA updates, and last contractor invoice date. Also advise on benefits effective date for 0.6 FTE.

Talia P: Last contractor invoice scheduled 2026-10-31. Will get candidate written confirmation on 0.6 FTE + benefits expectation by EOD.

Comp Chair: After review on Fri, comp committee will post decision. If committee approves base uplift, comp team will record exception and notify payroll/HR for onboarding. If denied, we will propose equity top-up or adjust banding.

Priya - People Ops: Great. I'll update HR-2987654321 with attachments and loop VP People if needed. Will post final outcome here once committee meets. :white_check_mark:
